newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet drifts lower with NYMEX, diffs mixed.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet drifts lower with NYMEX, diffs mixed.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices eased as NYMEX heating oil futures slipped lower late in the day, though differetials ended the day mixed.

U.S. Gulf 54-grade jet fuel for the delivery on the back 1st cycle on the Colonial Pipeline traded as low as 2.90 cents under the screen, while barrels for the 2nd cycle changed hands at about 2.50 cents under, slightly up on the day.
New York Harbor prompt 54-grade was talked modestly lower, hovering at 1.35 cents above the print, traders said.
NYMEX February heating oil moved up initially, but failed to sustain the strength and slipped lower trailing gasoline.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 259 2616
